hypothesis: A 64-D bilateral mean may retain the shared disease signal while removing redundant left/right/difference dimensions that increased representation shift.
folds: fixed 5 outer contexts x 3 inner validation folds
stop_rule: Retain as a simplified candidate only if three-seed mean BA, AUROC, and Macro-F1 are each within 0.005 of frozen V8-GN, neither class recall falls by more than 0.02, at least 7 of 15 seed-aggregated matched splits improve in BA, BA seed SD does not increase by more than 0.005, parameters decrease by at least 15 percent, and representation shift is not coherently worse.
